rule_b_fact: The frozen voice codebook counts a speaker naming a channel, show, website, offer, event or schedule as their own as own-voice evidence that can end a claimed-voice stretch; a bare request, link, price, date or event that names nothing as the speaker's own is no evidence either way, and selling alone neither starts nor ends a voice; whether an offer the claimed source names as its own counts is not specified by the frozen prompt; rule B (frozen label code) keeps the claimed voice over an offer-only own span directly after an unclosed claimed span; the asks prompts code every ask alike whoever speaks.
